latest_release.name: v2.3.1
latest_release.body:
DeepCode v2.3.1 is a stability release for the terminal UI on the shared background service. Answers now appear once and render as Markdown while they stream, the TUI survives a slow or restarted service, `/compact` works on coding sessions, and the background service no longer stops right after starting on Windows installs in a virtual environment. It also includes five community fixes and dependency security updates.

## Highlights

- **Answers shown once, rendered as Markdown.** The TUI no longer prints an answer a second time when it finishes, and a stopped answer keeps the text already shown. Headings, lists, bold text and tables are formatted as each line completes; code blocks are not indented or wrapped by DeepCode, so they copy back exactly; links show their address; and the line still being written is previewed above the status line. `/raw` prints answers exactly as written. The reasoning card comes before the answer, `Ctrl+O` mid-answer no longer repeats or drops lines, and text such as `root:x:0` or `:smile:` is no longer turned into emoji. See [The terminal UI](https://github.com/HKUDS/DeepCode/blob/v2.3.1/docs/guide/the-tui.md).
- **A TUI that keeps working.** A failed request, an unrenderable event, or a restarted service no longer closes the TUI; `/reconnect` starts the service again when needed. Typing, completion, `Enter` and `Ctrl+C` stay responsive while the service is busy, and a slow answer is reported instead of retried three times. `Esc` interrupts only from an empty prompt and `Ctrl+C` first clears your draft, so a message you are typing is never lost or sent by accident.
- **Settings that stay current.** Default model and access changes show up in the TUI, `/new` follows your defaults, an approval answered in another client is announced, and `/goal clear out …` sets a new objective instead of clearing the Goal.
- **`/compact` that works on coding sessions.** Compaction runs in its Session's turn, so a message sent meanwhile waits for the summary and the next reply does not start with a failed request. Tool-call arguments, such as the file a `write_file` call carries, now count, so a session that wrote large files compacts instead of being refused as "would not shrink". A refusal says why. (#258)
- **The Windows service stays up.** On a Windows install in a virtual environment, the background service stopped right after it reported ready, whichever of the TUI, `deepcode service start`, or `deepcode web` launched it. It now stays up.
- **Community fixes.** Diff lines that contain a Unicode line separator or a form feed stay whole (#253); web fetch refuses private addresses tunnelled through NAT64 or IPv4-compatible IPv6 (#254); the destructive-command screen also catches absolute paths such as `/bin/rm -rf /` (#255); and `glob` finds files when the project sits under a directory named `build` or `venv` (#256).
- **Security updates.** pypdf, PyJWT, urllib3, and multidict move to patched releases.

## Upgrading

`pip install -U deepcode-hku`, then `deepcode service restart` so the background service runs the new version. The TUI tells you when the client and the service versions differ.

## Thanks

This release includes contributions from @KennyMcSimpson, @raymondginger2018-sudo, @D41910, and @liuzhengyang699, and @raymondginger2018-sudo and @rifkir23 tracked down the cause of the failing Windows CI job. Thank you.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/HKUDS/DeepCode/compare/v2.3.0...v2.3.1

---

DeepCode v2.3.1 是一次针对共享后台服务下终端界面的稳定性更新：回答只显示一次，并且边输出边渲染成 Markdown；后台服务变慢或重启时 TUI 照常工作；`/compact` 能压缩写代码的会话；在 Windows 上把 DeepCode 装在虚拟环境里时，后台服务不再刚启动就退出。本版本还包含五项社区修复和依赖的安全更新。

## 亮点

- **回答只显示一次，并渲染成 Markdown。** 回答结束时，TUI 不再把整段重新打印一遍；被中断的回答会保留已经输出的文字。标题、列表、粗体和表格在每行写完时排好；代码块不缩进，DeepCode 也不会给它折行，复制出来和原文一致；链接显示完整地址；还没写完的那一行先在状态行上方预览。`/raw` 按原文输出。推理卡片显示在回答之前；回答途中按 `Ctrl+O` 不会再重复或丢行；`root:x:0`、`:smile:` 这类文字不再被替换成表情。参见[终端界面指南](https://github.com/HKUDS/DeepCode/blob/v2.3.1/docs/guide/the-tui.md)（英文）。
- **TUI 不再轻易中断。**
